ResultText:
The docs gate passes now. It had failed because the new constants live in `Starter.Domain`, and that module's `MODULE.md` hadn't changed.

I updated the lookup-types entry in `backend/src/Starter.Domain/MODULE.md` to list the `submission-channels` key and the `SubmissionChannelIds` values (WebPortal 1, WalkInCounter 2, PhoneCall 3, Email 4), seeded by `AddSubmissionChannelsLookup`.

The new-lookup scaffold edits the Lookups `MODULE.md` but not the `Starter.Domain` one, so every new lookup will hit this docs-gate failure. Teaching `tools/scaffold/new-lookup.mjs` to update that file too would stop it from happening again.

Still open from before: the full CI gate hasn't run, because the sandbox needs approval to start it. The Arabic names are still my own proposal and need someone to check them.
